SELECT NO , title , contents , category_no , user_no , create_time , update_time , views , is_admin FROM POST WHERE delete_time IS NULL
AND title like concat('%', #{title},'%')
AND contents like concat('%', #{contents},'%')
AND category_no = #{categoryNo}
ORDER BY create_time DESC
ORDER BY create_time ASC
ORDER BY category_no

SELECT p.no , p.title , p.contents , p.category_no , p.user_no , p.create_time , p.update_time , p.views , p.is_admin FROM POST p join post_tag pt on p.no = pt.post_no join tag t on pt.tag_no = t.no WHERE t.name = #{tagName}
